purpose: Services of the claims processes, added while designing. Physical placement is defined separately by the service deployment.

services.description: Sorts an insurance claim: a small claim is paid straight away, a larger one is assessed.
services.returns: The claim, its amount and the threshold. Routes on "simple" (paid) or "complex" (assessed).

services.description: Assesses a complex claim: accepts it up to 4,000 and rejects the rest. Called over REST: examples/rest/claims.js, hosted on Vercel.
services.returns: The assessment, with the claim, its amount and the limit. Routes on "accept" or "reject".
